```yaml
name: Docs Preview Deploy

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Docs Preview Build"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Download artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-preview
          path: docs-build
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          folder: docs-build
          branch: gh-pages
          target-folder: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}
          clean: false
          commit-message: "docs: deploy preview for PR #${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}"

  cleanup:
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].state == 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy
    steps:
      - name: Checkout gh-pages
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Remove preview folder
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER="${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}"
          if [ -d "$PR_NUMBER" ]; then
            rm -rf "$PR_NUMBER"
            git add -A
            git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git commit -m "docs: remove preview for closed PR #$PR_NUMBER" || echo "No changes to commit"
            git push origin gh-pages
          else
            echo "Preview folder for PR #$PR_NUMBER not found, skipping cleanup."
          fi

  skip-fork-notice:
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].head.repo.full_name != github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify fork PR skip
        run: |
          echo "Skipping deployment for fork PR #${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}. Only same-repo PRs are deployed."
```
